data.job_description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X!

We are CNN. THE WORLD'S MOST ESSENTIAL AND ENGAGING SOURCE OF DIGITAL NEWS. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and need our next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers who will lead and drive our growth. We aim to make the world a better, more connected place.

Your New Role...

The Staff Data Analyst, Audience Analytics & Insights, will lead efforts to deepen CNN’s understanding of audience discovery and growth across established and emerging platforms. In this role, you will lead the team’s understanding of which audiences engage with CNN across platforms and which channels drive new audience growth, informing editorial, product, revenue and marketing strategies. As an individual contributor, you will serve as a technical mentor and QA lead for the analyst team, ensuring analytical rigor and consistency across deliverables.
Your Role Accountabilities...
The Staff Data Analyst will:
• Lead ongoing analysis to identify opportunities for audience growth, including through search, generative AI platforms, social platforms, newsletters, and more.
• Partner with editorial, product, and marketing teams to translate audience analytics and insights into strategic recommendations.
• Regularly assess the impact of audience development initiatives.
• Serve as technical mentor and QA lead for the analyst team on web/app traffic trends, reviewing analytical methodologies, SQL queries, and dashboards to ensure accuracy and consistency.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret web and app traffic patterns, identify data quality issues, and collaborate with technical partners to clarify and resolve discrepancies.
• Develop and maintain a regular practice of landscape and competitive analytics that helps inform deliverables like benchmarking and forecasting to inform strategic planning and growth targets.
• Develop frameworks and reporting tools to monitor audience growth, segmentation, and discovery across platforms.
• Collaborate with the Senior Director to shape analytics roadmaps and OKRs aligned with business priorities.
• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in clear, compelling formats connected to the business impact.
Qualifications & Experience...
• 5+ years in digital analytics, audience insights, or audience development strategy.
• Strong command of SQL, experience with large datasets and ability to collaborate with data engineers to design and validate data pipelines. Experience with dbt is a plus but not required.
• Experience with SEO tools (e.g., Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs) and social analytics aggregation or owned platforms.
• Proven ability to evaluate experimental results.
• Proven ability to identify and estimate the potential drivers of audience growth.
• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
• Proficiency in digital analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Chartbeat, Parse.ly).
• Proven ability to develop and lead QA processes.
• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management experience.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
• Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD
Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $98,000.00 - $182,000.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: New Brunswick, NJ (Onsite – 2 days in a month)

Position Type: Fulltime position

Responsibilities:

Job Description:

Data Analyst is a detail-oriented technical analyst position that reports to the Operations Manager. The Data Analyst will be a team-player, responsible for compiling, analyzing, tracking program data, and reporting program information for all Programs. Other responsibilities will include developing and analyzing reports for energy efficiency measures and program performance, leading development and review of program documents and tools, tracking and analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs), supporting program evaluation, update of program planning tools and developing forecast and projection reports for the client.

Qualifications:
• Minimum 2 years of experience working in program design and/or implementation for utility or state-funded efficiency/renewable energy programs
• Bachelor’s Degree in technical discipline, like Engineering, Data Analytics, Physics, Mathematics, etc.
• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; expert with MS Excel
• Experience coding with Microsoft Visual Basic or similar programming languages
• Experience with relational database systems preferred
• Experience working with state and federal energy codes and regulations
• Experience with program evaluation processes and procedures
• Excellent research skills
• Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
• Demonstrated strategic thinking skills
• Experience working with and analyzing large datasets
• Ability to multitask, submit deliverables promptly, and be proactive
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work closely with other project team members
• Desire to develop existing and new skill sets in a collaborative, fast-paced environment
• Ability to write procedures and develop corresponding flow charts. Experience in Visio is a plus

Experience & Education:
• Minimum 2 years of experience working in program design and/or implementation for utility or state-funded efficiency/renewable energy programs
• Bachelor’s Degree in a technical discipline, like Engineering, Data Analytics, Physics, Mathematics, etc.

Responsibilities:
• Perform policy research on energy efficiency codes and standards at the state and federal levels for both current and future codes
• Perform a wide range of analyses, including analysis of program and portfolio performance, measure-level performance, project-level performance, and program-level impacts
• Perform benefit-cost analysis on prospective energy efficiency measures and programs in accordance with the New Jersey State Protocols, the New Jersey Coordinated Measure list, and other appropriate standards and guidelines
• Justify and document technical decisions related to research planning and data analysis
• Report and present findings, as well as actionable recommendations, to the internal technical services team and potentially the utility client
• Collaborate with program management staff and clients to meet program information and reporting needs
• Lead the development of program documents, including applications and energy savings models, and all other documents required for participants to engage energy efficiency programs; Perform document reviews
• Track and analyze internal key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare back up documents for the monthly invoices for the client; KPIs will include, but are not limited to, the following: completed projects or rebate applications, enrollments, committed funding, spent funding, estimated savings, number of participating trade allies, QC inspections/results (pass or fail), reporting accruals, explaining variances, etc.
• Develop and document data collection and tracking procedures as changes are made
• Supporting program evaluation procedures
• Develop energy-based assumptions using regression or other data mining and modeling techniques
• Perform other duties as required

Description

This role is contingent upon a contract award.

ICF is seeking an experienced Data Analytics Manager to lead enterprise data, analytics, governance, and AI-enabled capabilities for a complex federal technology services program. This role will support the design, implementation, and sustainment of data policy, standards, governance processes, portfolio management practices, data architecture, data quality controls, analytics products, dashboards, and secure data access models.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience leading enterprise data initiatives in regulated environments, with strong technical credibility across data governance, data architecture, data engineering, analytics, data quality, metadata management, and responsible AI-enabled analytics. This role requires the ability to translate business, operational, and mission needs into governed, secure, and usable data capabilities that support decision-making, performance management, and continuous improvement.

Job Location: This position is remote within the United States.

Please note that ICF monitors employee work locations, restricts access from foreign locations and IP addresses, and prohibits the use of personal VPN connections.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lead enterprise data, analytics, governance, and AI-enabled capability delivery across a complex federal technology environment.
• Develop and implement data governance policies, standards, operating procedures, approval workflows, and accountability models.
• Establish and maintain data portfolio management practices, including prioritization, project intake, resource planning, risk tracking, milestone reporting, and performance measurement.
• Lead the design and implementation of scalable data architecture, including data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, data catalogs, metadata repositories, and data lineage capabilities.
• Define and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, data dictionaries, scorecards, issue management workflows, and continuous monitoring processes.
• Guide development of analytics products, dashboards, reports, and visualization tools that provide operational insight and support executive decision-making.
• Support advanced analytics capabilities, including statistical analysis, predictive modeling, trend analysis, root cause analysis, and AI-enabled analytics.
• Ensure data sharing, API integration, and data access models are secure, governed, auditable, and aligned with privacy, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
• Partner with cybersecurity, engineering, product, and program management teams to align data platforms, applications, integrations, and analytics capabilities with enterprise standards.
• Establish reusable templates, frameworks, data models, ETL/ELT patterns, documentation repositories, and project management toolkits for data initiatives.
• Support training, documentation, and knowledge transfer to improve user adoption and long-term sustainment of data tools, dashboards, and data management practices.
• Monitor data quality, data usage, access patterns, and analytics adoption to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and operational blind spots.

What You Must Have
• U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust clearance.
• Bachelor’s Degree
• 10+ years of experience leading enterprise data, analytics, data governance, data engineering, data architecture, or AI-enabled analytics initiatives.
• One active data, cloud, analytics, AI/ML, or data governance certification, such as CDMP, DAMA, AWS/Azure/GCP data certification, Microsoft Power BI certification, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent

What we would like you to have:
• 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, or managing enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, data marts, data catalogs, or metadata management capabilities.
• 5+ years of experience establishing data governance policies, standards, stewardship models, data quality frameworks, data dictionaries, lineage practices, or data management operating models.
• 5+ years of experience delivering analytics products, dashboards, reporting capabilities, data visualizations, or executive decision-support tools.
• 5+ years of experience working in federal, public sector, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated environments with formal privacy, security, or compliance requirements.
• 3+ years of experience supporting AI-enabled analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning workflows, anomaly detection, or advanced analytics use cases.
• 3+ years of experience with data integration methods, including APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, data orchestration, batch processing, real-time ingestion, or change data capture.
• 3+ years of experience using data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QuickSight, Looker, Palantir Foundry, or similar platforms.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud data services on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud environments.
• Experience supporting HHS, NIH, FDA, CMS, CDC, or other health-focused federal environments.
• Experience building or supporting Chief Data Office functions, enterprise data governance programs, or data portfolio management organizations.
• Experience with data privacy, data protection, data classification, DLP, encryption, RBAC, ABAC, just-in-time access, or audit logging requirements.
• Experience aligning data capabilities with NIST, FISMA, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR, or other security and compliance frameworks.
• Experience developing data catalogs, metadata management approaches, lineage models, data quality scorecards, data issue repositories, and data stewardship workflows.
• Experience implementing AI governance, responsible AI practices, model monitoring, explainability, human-in-the-loop review, or secure AI-enabled analytics.
• Experience with SQL, Python, R, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Synapse, Dataverse, or similar data platforms and tools.
• Additional cloud, data, analytics, AI/ML, cybersecurity, Agile, ITIL, DAMA, CDMP, or project management certification.

The State Corporation Commission (SCC) seeks a Lead Data Analyst to join the Clerk’s Office and support strategic decisions through advanced data analysis, performance measurement, and reporting. Description

SAIC, a leading provider of systems development & deployment, targeting & intelligence analysis, systems engineering & integration, and solutions for the Intelligence Community, is seeking creative and dedicated professionals to fulfill their career goals and objectives while delivering mission excellence on programs of national importance.

SAIC is seeking a Data Analyst - Space Manager for the integration and application of advanced data analytics to solve complex business challenges and enhance mission security. The successful applicant will serve as a subject matter expert (SME), responsible for the entire lifecycle of data analysis, refining business requirements and developing sophisticated analytical models to provide strategic recommendations that improve organizational efficiency and mitigate insider threats. This role demands a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to lead, manage, and support critical operational and policy-related initiatives.

Work will be performed at the customer site in Springfield, VA.
• **The hiring of this position is contingent upon contract award. Anticipated award is fall of 2026.***
• This position will collaborate with project requestors, senior stakeholders, and program managers to define, clarify, and refine complex business needs and strategic objectives. Utilize data-driven insights to recommend significant changes and process improvements.
• This position will lead manage, and support business operations and policy development lifecycles. Serve as an SME for the development, review, coordination, promulgation, and compliance of enterprise-wide policies, including the maintenance of Self-Inspection Checklists and related documentation.
• This position will architect, develop, and maintain advanced analytic models, visualizations, and tools to deter, detect, and mitigate insider threats. Apply expert knowledge of industry-standard data science principles to identify anomalous events and provide actionable intelligence.
• This position will require candidates to translate complex quantitative and qualitative analysis into clear, compelling visuals, dashboards, and executive-level reports. Provide authoritative visual, technical, and editorial guidance, and confidently brief senior leadership on analytical findings, forecasts, and strategic recommendations.

Duties Include:
• The Contractor shall develop a physical space strategy that leverages technologies and/or tools to standardize and unify the management of physical space for the Analysis Directorate at customer sites in Washington, D.C. and St. Louis, MO.
• The Contractor shall coordinate this plan with the customer’s Security and Installations Directorate (SI) to ensure compliance with customer policy and other applicable DOW/IC regulations.
• The contractor shall deliver an implementation plan/strategy based on the approved recommendations from the Government lead that leverages technologies and/or tools to standardize and unify the management of physical space for the ASA Directorate at customer sites in Washington, D.C. and St. Louis, MO.
• Develop and maintain a physical space implementation plan for the ASA Directorate to include the ability to monitor and track vacancies, equipment (i.e., thick/thin client), optimal seating arrangements, and special needs for emergencies at customer sites in Washington, D.C. and St. Louis, MO. The contractor shall deliver this plan at a reasonable time to be determined by the Government.
• Leverage tools and/or technologies to develop and maintain a Tableau dashboard of all physical space activities such as monitor space requirements, real-time footprint, costs, risks, and challenges on a biannual basis. At a minimum, the dashboard data is to be refreshed once per week.
• In coordination with government, develop space management policies, procedures, and standards for ASA.
• Leverage tools and/or technologies to dynamically manage and visualize activities associated to physical space to include the ability to monitor and track vacancies, equipment (i.e., thick/thin client), optimal seating arrangements, and special needs for emergencies of all customer locations.
• A holistic strategy for managing physical space for the ASA Directorate that delivers a repeatable process for assessing the needs, availability, and priority of physical space, in alignment with SI.
• Leverage and integrate all sources of data from across customer sites that enable the accurate depiction of the Analysis footprint.
• As requested, provide an in-depth review of the Analysis physical space program to establish corporate governance forums.
• Identification and assessment of risks that could impede timely execution, and communicate anticipated changes and mitigation plans to the workforce and leadership via informal channels and established corporate governance forums.

Qualifications

Required Skills:
• A minimum of a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
• 7+ years proven experience in integrating, developing, and maintaining analytic models, visualizations, and tools, preferably in a security or threat-detection context. In lieu of a masters degree, 10+ years of experience. In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, 15+ years of experience.
• Expert-level knowledge of data analytics and data science principles, with a demonstrated ability to apply them to identify anomalous events and create data-driven forecasts.
• Extensive experience collaborating with stakeholders at all levels to define business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement initiatives and contribute to the full lifecycle of policy development and business operations.
• Mastery of data visualization and dashboard development using data sets from various sources.
• Exceptional ability to transform complex data sets into compelling visuals, reports, and briefings for leadership.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience providing technical and editorial guidance.
• Direct experience supporting and maintaining risk-scoring models or similar predictive analytic systems.
• Experience in a role requiring significant cross-functional collaboration and the ability to manage competing priorities.
• Proficiency in creating and editing visual content such as charts and graphs to represent data.
• At least 2 years demonstrated experience in one or more Geospatial Information Systems tools such as ArcView, ArcGIS, Remote View, ArcIMS, ERDAS Imagine, Remote View, ERDAS Imagine, Macromedia Dreamweaver, Macromedia Fireworks, Photoshop, HTML, and FrameMaker.
• Demonstrated coding experience to support writing scripts with tools such as but not limited to Java and Python.
• Demonstrated ability to use Share Point, Tableau, Redmine, and other systems/databases to manipulate and build data visualization.

Desired Skills:
• Experience in a leadership or mentorship role within a data analytics or business intelligence team.
• Familiarity with geospatial analysis, web development principles, or specific program leadership reporting structures.

Data Analyst (Population Health & Quality Improvement)

Reports To: Director, Population Health & Quality Improvement

Location: Washington, DC (Hybrid)

Position Purpose

If you’re someone who loves turning complex data into meaningful insights and wants your work to directly improve lives, this role is for you.
The Data Analyst supports population health and quality improvement efforts by analyzing client health and Medicaid claims data to identify care gaps, improve outcomes, and inform strategies that integrate behavioral health, case management, and primary care.

What You Will Do

• Analyze health and claims data to identify trends, gaps in care, and opportunities to improve outcomes.
• Support population health and quality improvement initiatives and value-based care strategies.
• Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from EHRs and claims systems.
• Build dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to communicate KPIs and insights to clinical and non-clinical audiences.
• Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to integrate and optimize data sources
• Ensure data accuracy through cleaning, validation, and documentation.
• Train staff on reporting tools and support data-driven workflows.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field + 5+ years of healthcare data analysis experience.
• Strong SQL skills (2–3+ years) and advanced Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
• Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
• Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
• Experience with healthcare data, Medicaid, HEDIS, or EHR systems (preferred).

Position Highlights

• Mission-driven work that improves outcomes for vulnerable populations.
• Direct impact on population health and integrated care strategies.
• Collaborative, purpose-driven team environment.
